scope.persona: Saudi-market first-core-software buyer, no shipped core product, no established software team and supported maximum two current software builders.
restrictions: No outreach, follows, connections, reactions, saves, subscriptions or account-setting changes.
No canonical lead, resource, persona or application changes.

methodology.unit: Visible top-level post impression inspected per query/filter pass; repeat appearances count again. Nested reposts, profile activity and article comments excluded from the 59.
methodology.sampling: Bounded convenience sample; personalized results, not exhaustive search coverage or unique candidate total. No controlled query experiment or commercial conversion test.
methodology.datePolicy: Keep literal relative labels; observation date is not publication date. Public/cache discrepancies retained.
methodology.sourceIndependence: Authored profile and post are the same person's evidence, not two independent publishers. Root and agent views of the same post do not add independent corroboration.
methodology.evidenceLimit: Zero current complete contractor-inclusive software-team upper bounds established; missing evidence stays unknown.

observedFreePostFilters: Past 24 hours, past week, past month

newsletterChecks.author: Mina Kerols
newsletterChecks.assessment: Market-entry context. Sampled article and its visible comment thread contained no explicit first-software-build request. Do not infer buying intent from readership or a founder commenter.

newsletterChecks.name: Building Between Markets
newsletterChecks.author: Yusra M.
newsletterChecks.assessment: Author's market-entry/relationship-building perspective; two external comments and an author reply did not describe an owned first-build project. Context source, not demonstrated high-yield buyer source.

recommendation: Use explicit project-request posts first and exact current pre-incubation cohort posts second. Keep buyer-intent evidence separate from persona eligibility. Buy no paid service yet.

nextExperiment.workflow: Two comparable research sessions; start Latest with recent request phrases, then exact current cohort; qualify only unique person-project records.
nextExperiment.stoppingRule: After two consecutive source passes contribute under 10% new evidence-supported candidates, retire or change the query and report shortfall; never fill a 50-lead quota with unknowns.
